verdict.rationale: Gumloop offers official Python and JavaScript SDKs (with a self-contained installer for the Python SDK) covering chat completions, agents, sessions, MCP, skills, and artifacts, plus API key/OAuth authentication and streaming support—clearly enabling AI-native developers to build against official SDKs. Missing for 10: independent/community corroboration beyond vendor docs and GitHub repo, and no public OpenAPI spec was found (probe returned 404s).
